title: Do shifted pages produce English?
question: Do any forward page-pair sums or differences at relative shifts with at least 120 overlapping runes score like English under the fixed GP-label quadgram model?
reader_question: Do shifted sums or differences of two pages score like English?
summary: None of 995,724 shifted arithmetic readings reaches the fixed English-recognition gate. The strongest score is ordinary among the shuffled search maxima.
finding: Best score -6.4925927001 is LP2-13 minus LP2-32 at shift 56 across 121 runes; zero streams reach -5.5. 100 of 128 full-search shuffle maxima score at least as highly, giving global plus-one comparison 0.7829457364. All 995,724 observed scores independently match exactly.
reader_finding: None passed the fixed English-recognition test. The strongest output, from LP2-13 minus LP2-32, scored like results commonly found in shuffled pages. The known-reading tests recovered the intended text.
reader_limit: Only addition and subtraction with at least 120 runes overlapping and one English-scoring model were tested. Extra decoding steps remain open.
limitations: 52 eligible pages from 55 nonempty LP2-00–55 pages; no shorter overlaps, reversal, wrapping, repetition, key skips or other layers. Whole-page shuffles preserve page frequencies but not every overlap histogram. Warning plants validate this direct construction, not every English passage or unrelated plaintexts encrypted with a shared key.
next_steps: A broader shared-keystream hypothesis needs a statistic and planted power controls matched to its plaintext relationship; do not treat absent English arithmetic output as general key-reuse exclusion.

scope.representation: Forward GP29 streams including headings from 55 nonempty LP2-00–55 pages; shifted overlaps of at least 120 runes; output scored as canonical GP Latin labels.
scope.procedure: Exhaust every eligible unordered pair and relative offset; score A+B, A-B and B-A modulo 29 with unchanged prior English scorer. Compare observed global best with 128 shared whole-page permutation search maxima.
scope.parameters: 1,326 pairs; 331,908 alignments; 995,724 streams, including 991,746 nonzero-offset streams and 3,978 baseline overlaps; at least 100 Latin quadgrams; fixed recognition gate -5.5; 128 null trials; seed 330120261025.
scope.exclusions: Overlap shorter than 120 runes, page reversal, wrapping, repeated or skipped key symbols, other arithmetic, altered transcription, word resets, additional cipher layers, other languages and general shared-key exclusion.

review.reviewer: Separate prior one-stream scorer with independent all-offset enumeration; all observed scores match exactly; independent control and null-winner checks

reader_title: Slide pages and look for English

reader_test.input: Pairs of LP2 pages with at least 120 runes overlapping.
reader_test.action: Slide one page along the other. At each alignment, add their numbers and try both subtraction directions.
reader_test.check: Check whether the outputs pass a fixed English-recognition test and compare the best score with shuffled-page searches.
